title: Listening Drill — Choosing fabrics for banners — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Choosing fabrics for banners — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on choosing fabrics for banners last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with faded cloth. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: torn edge.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of colour contrast so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow colour cards instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the banner maker before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
